{{< include ../_provenance.qmd >}}

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(igraph)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(hdWGCNA)
library(WGCNA)


theme_set(theme_cowplot())

# ── Palettes ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cond_pal <- c(WT = "#888888", `mCh-` = "#2a9d8f", `mCh+` = "#e76f51")

label_condition <- function(x) dplyr::case_when(
  grepl("WT",      x) ~ "WT",
  grepl("mCh-",   x) ~ "mCh-",
  grepl("mCh\\+", x) ~ "mCh+",
  TRUE                ~ x
)

CLUST_COL <- "sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9"
```

## Overview

hdWGCNA constructs gene co-expression modules from scRNA-seq data by first
aggregating cells into metacells (k-nearest-neighbour pseudobulk), then running
WGCNA soft-thresholding on the metacell expression matrix. This circumvents the
sparsity and technical noise inherent to single-cell count matrices.

**Object:** `mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc` — cell-cycle-regressed HSC Seurat object.
**Cluster column:** `sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9` (Leiden, res = 0.9).
**Metacell grouping:** per `sample.name` (preserves biological replication).

---

## 1 — Load data

```{r load}
targets::tar_load(hdwgcna_hsc_modules)
targets::tar_load(hdwgcna_hsc_hvg)
targets::tar_load(hdwgcna_hsc_soft_power)

srt      <- hdwgcna_hsc_modules
hvg      <- hdwgcna_hsc_hvg
soft_pow <- hdwgcna_hsc_soft_power
tom_dir  <- file.path("output", "objects", "hdwgcna")
rm(hdwgcna_hsc_modules, hdwgcna_hsc_hvg, hdwgcna_hsc_soft_power); gc()

DefaultAssay(srt) <- "SCT"
srt$condition <- label_condition(srt$sample.name) %>% setNames(.,names(srt$sample.name))

# umap.nn reduction is preserved through the hdWGCNA target chain
umap_df <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(srt, "umap.nn")) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id") |>
  dplyr::rename(UMAP1 = 2, UMAP2 = 3) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    cluster   = srt@meta.data[[CLUST_COL]],
    condition = srt$condition,
    sample    = srt$sample.name
  )

cat("Cells:", ncol(srt), "\n")
cat("Clusters:", nlevels(factor(umap_df$cluster)), "\n")
```

## 3 — Metacell aggregation

Metacells aggregate k nearest cells per `sample.name` group to obtain
pseudobulk-like profiles with reduced sparsity.

```{r metacells}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5

# Metacells loaded from hdwgcna_hsc_modules (cached via hdwgcna_hsc_metacells)
mc_obj <- GetMetacellObject(srt, wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")

# cells_in_metacell is a comma-separated barcode string; count elements
mc_sizes   <- stringr::str_count(mc_obj$cells_merged, ",") + 1L
mc_size_df <- data.frame(n_cells = mc_sizes)
mc_size_df$n_cells <- as.integer(as.character(mc_size_df$n_cells))

ggplot(mc_size_df, aes(n_cells)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  labs(title = "Metacell size distribution",
       x = "Cells per metacell", y = "Number of metacells") +
  theme_cowplot()
```

### 3.1 — Metacell UMAP placement

Metacells are placed at the **median UMAP coordinates** of their constituent
cells, then coloured by cluster majority vote and sized by cell count.

```{r metacell-umap}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 6
#| 
# Map each metacell → its constituent cell_ids
mc_cells <- mc_obj$cells_merged%>%
  str_split(",")
mc_cells_vec <- mc_obj$cells_merged%>%
  str_split(",") %>%
  stack %>% 
  with(setNames(.$ind %>% as.character(),
                .$value %>% as.character())
       ) 

# Median dimensionality reductions and add it to the metacell Seurat object
umap_cell_df <- Embeddings(srt,"umap.nn") %>% as.data.frame()
umap_metacell_df <- aggregate(umap_cell_df,
                     list(metacell_id = mc_cells_vec[rownames(umap_cell_df)]), 
                     median)
mc_obj[["umap_median"]] <- umap_metacell_df %>%
  column_to_rownames("metacell_id") %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  Seurat::CreateDimReducObject(key = "UMAPmed_")

pca_cell_df <- Embeddings(srt,"pca.SCT") %>% as.data.frame()
pca_metacell_df <- aggregate(pca_cell_df,
                     list(metacell_id = mc_cells_vec[rownames(pca_cell_df)]), 
                     median)
mc_obj[["pca_median"]] <- pca_metacell_df %>%
  column_to_rownames("metacell_id") %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  Seurat::CreateDimReducObject(key = "PCmed_")

# Median UMAP + majority cluster per metacell

mc_umap_coords <- purrr::map_dfr(names(mc_cells), function(mc_id) {
  cells <- mc_cells[[mc_id]]
  cells <- intersect(cells, umap_df$cell_id)
  sub <- umap_df[umap_df$cell_id %in% cells, ]
  tibble::tibble(
    metacell_id     = mc_id,
    UMAP1           = median(sub$UMAP1),
    UMAP2           = median(sub$UMAP2)
  )
})

mc_obj[["umap_meta"]] <- mc_umap_coords %>%
  column_to_rownames("metacell_id") %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  Seurat::CreateDimReducObject(key = "UMAP")

mc_meta <- purrr::map_dfr(names(mc_cells), function(mc_id) {
  cells <- mc_cells[[mc_id]]
  cells <- intersect(cells, umap_df$cell_id)
  if (length(cells) == 0) return(NULL)
  sub <- umap_df[umap_df$cell_id %in% cells, ]
  tibble::tibble(
    metacell_id     = mc_id,
    UMAP1           = median(sub$UMAP1),
    UMAP2           = median(sub$UMAP2),
    majority_cluster = names(sort(table(sub$cluster), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
    majority_cond    = names(sort(table(sub$condition), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
    n_cells          = nrow(sub)
  )
})


clust_levels <- sort(unique(umap_df$cluster))
clust_pal    <- setNames(
  scales::hue_pal()(length(clust_levels)),
  clust_levels
)

p_cells <- ggplot(umap_df, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = clust_pal) +
  labs(title = "Cells — coloured by cluster") +
  theme_void() +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)))

p_mc <- ggplot(mc_meta, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2,
                               colour = majority_cluster)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = clust_pal) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 5), name = "cells") +
  labs(title = "Metacells — median UMAP, majority cluster") +
  theme_void() +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)))

p_mc_cond <- ggplot(mc_meta, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2,
                                    colour = majority_cond)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cond_pal,
                      breaks = names(cond_pal)) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 5), name = "cells") +
  labs(title = "Metacells — majority condition") +
  theme_void() +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)))

p_cells | p_mc | p_mc_cond
```

## 6 — Module eigengenes & connectivity

```{r eigengenes}
# ScaleData + ModuleEigengenes + ModuleConnectivity cached in hdwgcna_hsc_modules
```

```{r module-summary}
modules <- GetModules(srt, wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")

module_summary <- modules |>
  dplyr::filter(module != "grey") |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols      = dplyr::starts_with("kME_"),
    names_to  = "kME_module",
    values_to = "kME"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(kME_module == paste0("kME_", module)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(module) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_genes   = dplyr::n(),
    top_genes = paste(gene_name[order(-kME)][1:5], collapse = ", "),
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(module)

DT::datatable(module_summary,
              rownames = FALSE,
              caption  = "Module summary — top 5 hub genes by kME",
              options  = list(pageLength = 20, scrollY = "400px"))
```

## 7 — Module eigengene UMAP

```{r me-umap}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 10

me_df <- GetMEs(srt, wgcna_name = "hsc_modules") |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id")

me_df <- dplyr::left_join(
  umap_df[, c("cell_id", "UMAP1", "UMAP2")],
  me_df, by = "cell_id"
)

mod_cols <- setdiff(colnames(me_df), c("cell_id", "UMAP1", "UMAP2"))
mod_cols <- mod_cols[mod_cols != "grey"]

plots <- lapply(mod_cols, function(m) {
  ggplot(me_df, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = .data[[m]])) +
    geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_colour_gradientn(
      colours  = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")),
      name     = "ME",
      limits   = c(-1, 1),
      oob      = scales::squish
    ) +
    ggtitle(m) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5))
})

patchwork::wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 6) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(title = "Module eigengene UMAPs")
```

## 9 — Hub gene heatmap

ComplexHeatmap of the top hub genes per module (by kME), cells ordered by
Leiden cluster (pre-computed by Seurat), genes grouped by module.

```{r hub-heatmap-cell}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 10

N_HUB <- 25  # top hub genes per module

# hub_genes <- modules |>
#   dplyr::filter(module != "grey") |>
#   dplyr::rowwise() |>
#   dplyr::mutate(kME = .data[[paste0("kME_", module)]]) |>
#   dplyr::ungroup() |>
#   dplyr::group_by(module) |>
#   dplyr::slice_max(order_by = kME, n = N_HUB) |>
#   dplyr::ungroup()
hub_genes <- modules %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = kME_green:kME_blue) %>%
  group_by(module) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = value, n = N_HUB)%>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct(gene_name, color, module)

genes_use  <- hub_genes$gene_name
cells_use  <- colnames(srt)

mat_hub <- GetAssayData(srt, assay = "SCT", layer = "data")[genes_use, cells_use]
mat_hub <- as.matrix(mat_hub)

# Z-score per gene
mat_hub <- t(scale(t(mat_hub)))
mat_hub[mat_hub >  2] <-  2
mat_hub[mat_hub < -2] <- -2

# optimal ordering of the matrix
ser_method <- "PCA" #PCA, PCA_angel, Heatmap(slow and memory intensive)

# Seriate columns globally
o_cols  <- seriation::seriate(mat_hub, method = ser_method) %>% seriation::get_order(2) %>% rev() %>% sample()
o_cells <- colnames(mat_hub)[o_cols]

# Seriate genes within each module independently
o_genes <- hub_genes %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_name, module) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(module) %>%
  dplyr::group_map(function(mod_df, key) {
    genes_mod <- intersect(mod_df$gene_name, rownames(mat_hub))
    if (length(genes_mod) <= 2L) return(genes_mod)
    sub_mat <- mat_hub[genes_mod, , drop = FALSE]
    tryCatch({
      o <- seriation::seriate(sub_mat, method = ser_method) %>%
           seriation::get_order(1L) %>% rev()
      genes_mod[o]
    }, error = function(e) genes_mod)
  }) %>%
  unlist(use.names = FALSE)

# ── Column ordering: cluster → condition → seriation rank ────────────────────
cell_meta  <- srt@meta.data[cells_use, ]
ser_rank   <- setNames(seq_along(o_cells), o_cells)

col_df <- tibble::tibble(
  cell_id   = colnames(mat_hub),
  cluster   = factor(cell_meta[[CLUST_COL]], levels = sort(unique(cell_meta[[CLUST_COL]]))),
  condition = factor(cell_meta$condition,    levels = c("WT", "mCh-", "mCh+")),
  ser_rank  = ser_rank[colnames(mat_hub)]
) |>
  dplyr::arrange(cluster, condition, ser_rank)

final_cells <- col_df$cell_id
clust_split <- col_df$cluster   # factor preserves cluster order for anno_block
clust_labs  <- levels(clust_split)

# ── Column annotation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
col_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  cluster = anno_block(
    gp        = gpar(fill = clust_pal[clust_labs]),
    labels    = clust_labs,
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7, col = "white", fontface = "bold")
  ),
  condition = col_df$condition,
  col  = list(condition = cond_pal),
  annotation_name_side = "left"
)

# ── Row annotation — module colour bar ────────────────────────────────────────
row_anno <- rowAnnotation(
  module = setNames(hub_genes$module, hub_genes$gene_name)[o_genes],
  col    = list(module = setNames(
    unique(hub_genes$color),
    unique(hub_genes$module)
  )),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

Heatmap(
  mat_hub[o_genes, final_cells],
  name                    = "z-score",
  col                     = colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2),
                                       c("#2166ac", "white", "#b2182b")),
  top_annotation          = col_anno,
  left_annotation         = row_anno,
  column_split            = clust_split,
  column_title            = NULL,
  row_split               = setNames(hub_genes$module, hub_genes$gene_name)[o_genes],
  cluster_rows            = FALSE,
  cluster_columns         = FALSE,
  show_column_names       = FALSE,
  show_row_names          = TRUE,
  row_names_gp            = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  row_title_rot           = 0,
  use_raster              = TRUE,
  raster_quality          = 3
)
```

```{r hub-heatmap-metacell}

#| fig-height: 10

# hub_genes <- modules |>
#   dplyr::filter(module != "grey") |>

row_anno <- rowAnnotation(
```

## 10 — Module–trait correlation

Pearson correlation between module eigengenes and condition (one-hot encoded),
coloured by significance.

```{r trait-correlation}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6

me_mat <- GetMEs(srt, wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")
me_mat <- me_mat[, mod_cols, drop = FALSE]

# One-hot encode conditions
cond_vec <- label_condition(srt$sample.name)
trait_mat <- model.matrix(~ 0 + factor(cond_vec))
colnames(trait_mat) <- levels(factor(cond_vec))

# Pearson r + BH-adjusted p
cor_res  <- WGCNA::corAndPvalue(me_mat, trait_mat)
r_mat    <- cor_res$cor
p_mat    <- cor_res$p
q_mat    <- matrix(p.adjust(p_mat, "BH"), nrow = nrow(p_mat),
                   dimnames = dimnames(p_mat))

sig_mat <- ifelse(q_mat < 0.05, "*", "")

Heatmap(
  r_mat,
  name     = "Pearson r",
  col      = colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("#2166ac", "white", "#b2182b")),
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    if (sig_mat[i, j] != "")
      grid::grid.text(sig_mat[i, j], x, y, gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"))
  },
  cluster_rows    = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  row_names_gp    = gpar(fontsize = 9),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
  column_title    = "Condition",
  row_title       = "Module"
)
```

## 11 — TF network (vanilla MotifScan)

Identifies transcription factors whose binding motifs are enriched in the
promoters of hub genes in each module (JASPAR 2024 CORE, mouse).
Follows the [hdWGCNA TF network vignette](https://smorabit.github.io/hdWGCNA/articles/tf_network.html).

**Required packages** (Bioconductor; installed with the others by scripts/R/install-r-packages.R):
`JASPAR2024`, `TFBSTools`, `BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10`, `EnsDb.Mmusculus.v79`.

```{r tf-pkgs}
library(JASPAR2024)
library(TFBSTools)
library(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)
library(EnsDb.Mmusculus.v79)
library(circlize)        # colorRamp2 for heatmap colour scale
library(ComplexHeatmap)  # motif enrichment heatmap
```

### 11.1 — Motif scan

```{r motif-scan}
# JASPAR 2024 CORE mouse motifs via TFBSTools (no chromVAR dependency)
pfm_set <- TFBSTools::getMatrixSet(
  x    = JASPAR2024()@db,
  opts = list(collection  = "CORE",
              tax_id      = list(10090),   # Mus musculus
              all_versions = FALSE,
              matrixtype  = "PFM")
)
cat("Motifs loaded:", length(pfm_set), "\n")

srt <- MotifScan(
  srt,
  species_genome = "mm10",
  pfm            = pfm_set,
  EnsDb          = EnsDb.Mmusculus.v79,
  wgcna_name     = "hsc_modules"
)
```

### 11.2 — Overlap motifs with modules

```{r motif-overlap}
srt <- OverlapModulesMotifs(srt, wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")

motif_df <- GetMotifOverlap(srt, wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")

# GetMotifs: per-TF rows for motifs whose TF gene is expressed in the dataset
# (85 expressed TFs out of 2346 total motifs scanned)
# motif_name is the gene symbol; motif_ID is the JASPAR accession
motif_genes_df <- GetMotifs(srt)

# Annotate motif_df with readable TF gene symbols from GetMotifs
motif_df <- dplyr::left_join(
  motif_df,
  motif_genes_df[, c("motif_ID", "motif_name")],
  by = c("tf" = "motif_ID")
)

# ConstructTFNetwork: expand gene set to include TF genes + all non-grey module genes,
# re-run SetDatExpr, then fit XGBoost regulatory models
tf_genes      <- unique(motif_genes_df$gene_name)
modules_net   <- GetModules(srt, wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")
nongrey_genes <- subset(modules_net, module != "grey")$gene_name
genes_use     <- unique(c(tf_genes, nongrey_genes))

srt <- SetWGCNAGenes(srt, genes_use, wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")
srt <- SetDatExpr(srt,
                  group_name = unique(srt$sample.name),
                  group.by   = "sample.name",
                  assay      = "SCT",
                  layer      = "data",
                  wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")

model_params <- list(
  objective = "reg:squarederror",
  max_depth = 1,
  eta       = 0.1,
  nthread   = 16,
  alpha     = 0.5
)
srt <- ConstructTFNetwork(
  srt,
  model_params = model_params,
  wgcna_name   = "hsc_modules"
)

cat("motif_df rows:", nrow(motif_df), "\n")
```

### 11.3 — TF regulons

Define TF regulons by filtering TF–target connections. Strategy "C" retains all
pairs above a regulatory score threshold (other options: "A" = top TFs per gene,
"B" = top genes per TF).

```{r tf-regulons}
srt <- AssignTFRegulons(
  srt,
  strategy   = "C",
  reg_thresh = 0.1,
  wgcna_name = "hsc_modules"
)

results <- GetTFNetwork(srt, wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")
cat("TF–gene pairs after regulon assignment:", nrow(results), "\n")
```

### 11.4 — Top TF targets

```{r regulon-barplot}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
cur_tf <- "Foxo1"
RegulonBarPlot(srt, selected_tf = cur_tf, wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")
```

### 11.5 — Regulon scores

Compute per-cell positive and negative regulon activity scores for each TF.

```{r regulon-scores}
srt <- RegulonScores(
  srt,
  target_type        = "positive",
  exclude_grey_genes = FALSE,
  cor_thresh         = 0.05,
  ncores             = 8,
  wgcna_name         = "hsc_modules"
)
srt <- RegulonScores(
  srt,
  target_type        = "negative",
  exclude_grey_genes = FALSE,
  cor_thresh         = -0.05,
  ncores             = 8,
  wgcna_name         = "hsc_modules"
)

pos_regulon_scores <- GetRegulonScores(srt, target_type = "positive",
                                       wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")
neg_regulon_scores <- GetRegulonScores(srt, target_type = "negative",
                                       wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")

cat("Regulon score matrix dims (pos):", dim(pos_regulon_scores), "\n")
```

### 11.6 — Regulon UMAP

```{r regulon-umap}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 4

srt$pos_regulon_score <- pos_regulon_scores[, cur_tf]
srt$neg_regulon_score <- neg_regulon_scores[, cur_tf]

p1 <- FeaturePlot(srt, feature = cur_tf) + umap_theme()
p2 <- FeaturePlot(srt, feature = "pos_regulon_score",
                  cols = c("lightgrey", "red")) + umap_theme()
p3 <- FeaturePlot(srt, feature = "neg_regulon_score",
                  cols = c("lightgrey", "seagreen")) + umap_theme()
p1 | p2 | p3
```

### 11.7 — Module regulatory heatmap

```{r regulon-module-heatmap}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6

p1 <- ModuleRegulatoryHeatmap(srt, feature = "positive",
                               high_color = "orange2",
                               wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")
p2 <- ModuleRegulatoryHeatmap(srt, feature = "negative",
                               high_color = "dodgerblue",
                               wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")
p1 | p2
```

### 11.8 — TF regulon–trait correlation

Pearson correlation between positive regulon scores and condition (one-hot
encoded). `*` marks BH-adjusted q < 0.0005.

```{r regulon-trait-correlation}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6

# One-hot encode conditions
cond_vec <- label_condition(srt$sample.name)
trait_mat <- model.matrix(~ 0 + factor(cond_vec))
colnames(trait_mat) <- levels(factor(cond_vec))

# Pearson r + BH-adjusted p
cor_res  <- WGCNA::corAndPvalue(pos_regulon_scores, trait_mat)
r_mat    <- cor_res$cor
p_mat    <- cor_res$p
q_mat    <- matrix(p.adjust(p_mat, "BH"), nrow = nrow(p_mat),
                   dimnames = dimnames(p_mat))

sig_mat <- ifelse(q_mat < 0.0005, "*", "")

Heatmap(
  r_mat,
  name     = "Pearson r",
  col      = colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("#2166ac", "white", "#b2182b")),
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    if (sig_mat[i, j] != "")
      grid::grid.text(sig_mat[i, j], x, y, gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"))
  },
  cluster_rows    = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  row_names_gp    = gpar(fontsize = 9),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
  column_title    = "Condition",
  row_title       = "Module"
)
```

### 11.9 — Regulon activity heatmap by cluster

Mean positive-regulon score per cluster (z-scored within each TF), clustered with
Ward.D2 on both rows and columns. Structure mirrors the SCENIC AUC heatmap.

```{r regulon-cluster-heatmap}
#| fig-height: 16
#| fig-width: 14

# Aggregate per-cell positive-regulon scores → cluster means
shared_cells_reg <- intersect(rownames(pos_regulon_scores), colnames(srt))
reg_mat  <- pos_regulon_scores[shared_cells_reg, , drop = FALSE]
cl_vec   <- srt@meta.data[shared_cells_reg, CLUST_COL]

agg      <- rowsum(reg_mat, cl_vec)                   # clusters × TFs
cl_n     <- as.numeric(table(cl_vec)[rownames(agg)])
agg_mean <- sweep(agg, 1, cl_n, "/")                  # mean per cluster

# Z-score each TF across clusters → TFs × clusters
heat_reg <- t(scale(agg_mean))
heat_reg <- heat_reg[complete.cases(heat_reg), ]       # drop zero-variance TFs

# Ward.D2 hierarchical clustering
hc_rows_reg <- hclust(dist(heat_reg),    method = "ward.D2")
hc_cols_reg <- hclust(dist(t(heat_reg)), method = "ward.D2")

# Condition proportions per cluster for annotation bar
cond_cells <- srt$condition[shared_cells_reg]
prop_reg   <- prop.table(table(cl_vec, cond_cells), margin = 1)
prop_reg   <- as.matrix(prop_reg)
cond_ord   <- intersect(c("WT", "mCh-", "mCh+"), colnames(prop_reg))
prop_reg   <- prop_reg[rownames(agg_mean), cond_ord, drop = FALSE]

col_ann_reg <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  `Condition mix` = anno_barplot(
    prop_reg,
    ylim       = c(0, 1), bar_width = 0.9,
    gp         = gpar(fill = cond_pal[cond_ord], col = NA),
    axis_param = list(side = "left", gp = gpar(fontsize = 7))
  ),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  annotation_name_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 8)
)

draw(
  Heatmap(
    heat_reg,
    name                 = "z-score\nmean score",
    col                  = colorRamp2(c(-2.5, 0, 2.5), c("#2166ac", "white", "#b2182b")),
    top_annotation       = col_ann_reg,
    cluster_rows         = as.dendrogram(hc_rows_reg),
    cluster_columns      = as.dendrogram(hc_cols_reg),
    column_names_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 9),
    row_names_gp         = gpar(fontsize = 8),
    border               = FALSE,
    column_title         = sprintf("%d clusters — positive regulon scores", ncol(heat_reg)),
    column_title_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 9),
    heatmap_legend_param = list(direction = "vertical")
  ),
  heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right"
)
```

### 11.10 — Regulon-activity embedding UMAP

Cell layout driven by positive TF regulon activity scores (PCA → UMAP).
Left: regulon-activity embedding coloured by SCT cluster. Right: original
SCT gene-expression embedding for comparison.

```{r reg-umap-fn}
build_regulon_umap <- function(srt, pos_scores, suffix, n_pcs = 30L, k = 20L) {
  shared_cells <- intersect(rownames(pos_scores), colnames(srt))
  mat_tfc <- Matrix::Matrix(
    t(pos_scores[shared_cells, , drop = FALSE]), sparse = TRUE
  )
  assay_name <- paste0("RegScore_", suffix)
  srt[[assay_name]] <- SeuratObject::CreateAssay5Object(data = mat_tfc)
  DefaultAssay(srt)  <- assay_name
  srt <- Seurat::ScaleData(srt,
                            features  = rownames(srt[[assay_name]]),
                            do.scale  = TRUE, do.center = TRUE,
                            verbose   = FALSE)
  n_pcs_use <- min(n_pcs, nrow(srt[[assay_name]]) - 1L)
  pca_name  <- paste0("pca_reg_", suffix)
  nn_name   <- paste0("nn_reg_", suffix)
  umap_name <- paste0("umap_reg_", suffix)
  srt <- Seurat::RunPCA(srt,
                         features       = rownames(srt[[assay_name]]),
                         npcs           = n_pcs_use,
                         reduction.name = pca_name,
                         reduction.key  = paste0(suffix, "PC_"),
                         verbose        = FALSE)
  srt <- Seurat::FindNeighbors(srt,
                                dims            = seq_len(n_pcs_use),
                                reduction       = pca_name,
                                k.param         = k,
                                compute.SNN     = TRUE,
                                graph.name      = nn_name,
                                return.neighbor = TRUE)
  srt <- Seurat::RunUMAP(srt,
                          n.neighbors    = k,
                          nn.name        = nn_name,
                          reduction.name = umap_name,
                          reduction.key  = paste0(suffix, "UMAP_"),
                          verbose        = FALSE)
  DefaultAssay(srt) <- "SCT"
  srt
}
```

```{r reg-umap-vanilla}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 5

srt <- build_regulon_umap(srt, pos_regulon_scores, suffix = "vanilla")

DimPlot(srt, group.by = CLUST_COL, reduction = "umap_reg_vanilla",
        label = TRUE) & NoLegend() |
  DimPlot(srt, group.by = CLUST_COL, reduction = "umap.nn",
          label = TRUE) & NoLegend()
```

```{r reg-umap-vanilla-cond}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 5

DimPlot(srt, group.by = "condition", reduction = "umap_reg_vanilla") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cond_pal, name = "Condition") |
  DimPlot(srt, group.by = "condition", reduction = "umap.nn") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cond_pal, name = "Condition")
```

```{r reg-umap-vanilla-split}
#| fig-width: 18
#| fig-height: 4

DimPlot(srt, group.by = "condition", reduction = "umap_reg_vanilla",
        split.by = "sample.name") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cond_pal, name = "Condition")
```

## 12 — Promoters only

Motif scanning restricted to gene promoter windows — equivalent to the vanilla
`hdWGCNA::MotifScan` in §11, but via `AugmentMotifScanWithBED`. Serves as
baseline to isolate the contribution of ATAC accessibility.

**Packages and data are loaded here and reused in §13–§14.**

```{r aug-pkgs}
library(motifmatchr)
```

```{r aug-load}
yoshida_2020_ocr_linked_orig     <- targets::tar_read(yoshida_2020_ocr_linked_orig)
mm10_protein_coding_promoters_gr <- targets::tar_read(mm10_protein_coding_promoters_gr)
atac_info <- targets::tar_read(yoshida_2020_ocr_df)
cat(sprintf("ImmGenATAC18: %d peaks total; %d gene-linked (orig TSS/100kb)\n",
            nrow(atac_info), length(yoshida_2020_ocr_linked_orig$gr)))
cat(sprintf("Promoters: %d transcripts, %d genes\n",
            length(mm10_protein_coding_promoters_gr),
            length(unique(mm10_protein_coding_promoters_gr$symbol))))
```

`AugmentMotifScanWithBED` accepts a named list of GRanges objects. Each element
is either a **GRanges with `$symbol`** (promoters — direct transcript → gene
mapping) or a **`list($gr, $peak_gene)`** (pre-linked ranges from
`link_ranges_to_genes`). All elements are scanned in a single `matchMotifs`
call and contributions are OR-combined via sparse matrix products.

```{r aug-def}
AugmentMotifScanWithBED <- function(
  seurat_obj,
  gr_list,
  pfm,
  species_genome = "mm10",
  wgcna_name     = NULL
) {
  if (is.null(wgcna_name)) wgcna_name <- seurat_obj@misc$active_wgcna
  hdWGCNA::CheckWGCNAName(seurat_obj, wgcna_name)

  wgcna_genes <- hdWGCNA::GetWGCNAGenes(seurat_obj, wgcna_name = wgcna_name)

  motif_df <- data.frame(
    motif_name = purrr::map_chr(seq_along(pfm), ~ pfm[[.x]]@name),
    motif_ID   = purrr::map_chr(seq_along(pfm), ~ pfm[[.x]]@ID),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  elem_grs <- lapply(gr_list, function(e)
    if (methods::is(e, "GRanges")) e else e$gr
  )

  scan_gr <- do.call(c, unname(lapply(elem_grs, GenomicRanges::granges)))
  GenomeInfoDb::genome(GenomeInfoDb::seqinfo(scan_gr)) <- species_genome

  cat(sprintf("[AugmentMotifScanWithBED] Scanning %d regions (%s)...\n",
              length(scan_gr),
              paste(sprintf("%d %s", lengths(elem_grs), names(elem_grs)),
                    collapse = " + ")))

  motif_res <- motifmatchr::matchMotifs(pfm, scan_gr, genome = species_genome)
  all_match <- motifmatchr::motifMatches(motif_res)
  colnames(all_match) <- motif_df$motif_ID
  rm(motif_res, scan_gr); invisible(gc())

  offset   <- 0L
  tf_match <- NULL

  for (nm in names(gr_list)) {
    elem    <- gr_list[[nm]]
    n_rows  <- length(elem_grs[[nm]])
    e_match <- all_match[(offset + 1L):(offset + n_rows), , drop = FALSE]
    offset  <- offset + n_rows

    if (methods::is(elem, "GRanges")) {
      row_ids <- as.character(seq_len(n_rows))
      pg <- data.frame(rng_id = row_ids, gene = elem$symbol,
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      pg <- pg[!is.na(pg$gene), ]
      rownames(e_match) <- row_ids
    } else {
      rownames(e_match) <- names(elem$gr)
      pg <- data.frame(rng_id = elem$peak_gene$reduced_name,
                       gene   = elem$peak_gene$gene,
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }

    gl <- wgcna_genes[wgcna_genes %in% pg$gene]
    pg <- pg[pg$gene %in% gl & pg$rng_id %in% rownames(e_match), ]

    if (length(gl) > 0 && nrow(pg) > 0) {
      g_idx    <- setNames(seq_along(gl), gl)
      rgn_gene <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(
        i        = match(pg$rng_id, rownames(e_match)),
        j        = g_idx[pg$gene],
        x        = 1L,
        dims     = c(nrow(e_match), length(gl)),
        dimnames = list(rownames(e_match), gl)
      )
      contrib <- Matrix::t(rgn_gene) %*% methods::as(e_match, "dgCMatrix")
      contrib <- contrib > 0L
      rm(rgn_gene)
    } else {
      contrib <- NULL
    }
    rm(e_match); invisible(gc())

    if (!is.null(contrib)) {
      if (is.null(tf_match)) {
        tf_match <- contrib
      } else {
        shared  <- intersect(rownames(tf_match), rownames(contrib))
        only_tf <- setdiff(rownames(tf_match), rownames(contrib))
        only_c  <- setdiff(rownames(contrib),  rownames(tf_match))
        tf_match <- rbind(
          tf_match[shared, , drop = FALSE] | contrib[shared, , drop = FALSE],
          tf_match[only_tf, , drop = FALSE],
          contrib[only_c,   , drop = FALSE]
        )
      }
    }
  }
  rm(all_match); invisible(gc())

  if (is.null(tf_match))
    stop("[AugmentMotifScanWithBED] No gene–motif hits found across all elements.")

  tf_targets <- setNames(
    lapply(colnames(tf_match), function(m)
      names(which(as.logical(tf_match[, m])))),
    colnames(tf_match)
  )
  motif_df$n_targets <- lengths(tf_targets)

  tfs_fix <- names(which(table(motif_df$motif_name) > 1))
  for (cur_tf in tfs_fix) {
    cur_idx <- as.numeric(rownames(subset(motif_df, motif_name == cur_tf)))
    tf_targets[[cur_tf]] <- unique(unlist(tf_targets[cur_idx]))
  }

  tmp <- gsub("\\(.*\\)", "", motif_df$motif_name)
  tmp <- gsub("::", ",", tmp)
  names(tmp) <- motif_df$motif_ID

  motif_df_out <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(tmp), function(i) {
    x  <- tmp[[i]]; id <- names(tmp)[i]
    if (grepl(",", x)) x <- unlist(strsplit(x, ","))
    data.frame(motif_ID = id, gene_name = trimws(x), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
  ix <- match(motif_df_out$motif_ID, motif_df$motif_ID)
  motif_df_out <- cbind(motif_df_out, motif_df[ix, c("motif_name", "n_targets")])
  rownames(motif_df_out) <- seq_len(nrow(motif_df_out))
  motif_df_out <- dplyr::select(motif_df_out,
                                 motif_ID, motif_name, n_targets, gene_name)
  motif_df_out <- subset(motif_df_out, gene_name %in% rownames(seurat_obj))

  seurat_obj <- hdWGCNA::SetMotifMatrix(seurat_obj,  tf_match)
  seurat_obj <- hdWGCNA::SetMotifs(seurat_obj,       motif_df_out)
  seurat_obj <- hdWGCNA::SetMotifTargets(seurat_obj, tf_targets)
  seurat_obj <- hdWGCNA::SetPFMList(seurat_obj,      pfm)

  cat(sprintf("[AugmentMotifScanWithBED] Done: %d genes × %d motifs\n",
              nrow(tf_match), ncol(tf_match)))
  seurat_obj
}
```

### 12.7 — Module regulatory heatmap

```{r prom-regulon-module-heatmap}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6

p1 <- ModuleRegulatoryHeatmap(srt, feature = "positive",
                               high_color = "orange2",
                               wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")
p2 <- ModuleRegulatoryHeatmap(srt, feature = "negative",
                               high_color = "dodgerblue",
                               wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")
p1 | p2
```

### 12.8 — TF regulon–trait correlation

Pearson correlation between positive regulon scores and condition (one-hot
encoded). `*` marks BH-adjusted q < 0.0005.

```{r prom-regulon-trait-correlation}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6

cond_vec  <- label_condition(srt$sample.name)
trait_mat <- model.matrix(~ 0 + factor(cond_vec))
colnames(trait_mat) <- levels(factor(cond_vec))

cor_res  <- WGCNA::corAndPvalue(pos_regulon_scores, trait_mat)
r_mat    <- cor_res$cor
p_mat    <- cor_res$p
q_mat    <- matrix(p.adjust(p_mat, "BH"), nrow = nrow(p_mat),
                   dimnames = dimnames(p_mat))
sig_mat  <- ifelse(q_mat < 0.0005, "*", "")

Heatmap(
  r_mat,
  name     = "Pearson r",
  col      = colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("#2166ac", "white", "#b2182b")),
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    if (sig_mat[i, j] != "")
      grid::grid.text(sig_mat[i, j], x, y, gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"))
  },
  cluster_rows    = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  row_names_gp    = gpar(fontsize = 9),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
  column_title    = "Condition",
  row_title       = "Module"
)
```

### 12.9 — Regulon activity heatmap by cluster

Mean positive-regulon score per cluster (z-scored within each TF), clustered
with Ward.D2 on both rows and columns.

```{r prom-regulon-cluster-heatmap}
#| fig-height: 16
#| fig-width: 14

shared_cells_reg <- intersect(rownames(pos_regulon_scores), colnames(srt))
reg_mat  <- pos_regulon_scores[shared_cells_reg, , drop = FALSE]
cl_vec   <- srt@meta.data[shared_cells_reg, CLUST_COL]

agg      <- rowsum(reg_mat, cl_vec)
cl_n     <- as.numeric(table(cl_vec)[rownames(agg)])
agg_mean <- sweep(agg, 1, cl_n, "/")

heat_reg <- t(scale(agg_mean))
heat_reg <- heat_reg[complete.cases(heat_reg), ]

hc_rows_reg <- hclust(dist(heat_reg),    method = "ward.D2")
hc_cols_reg <- hclust(dist(t(heat_reg)), method = "ward.D2")

cond_cells <- srt$condition[shared_cells_reg]
prop_reg   <- prop.table(table(cl_vec, cond_cells), margin = 1)
prop_reg   <- as.matrix(prop_reg)
cond_ord   <- intersect(c("WT", "mCh-", "mCh+"), colnames(prop_reg))
prop_reg   <- prop_reg[rownames(agg_mean), cond_ord, drop = FALSE]

col_ann_reg <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  `Condition mix` = anno_barplot(
    prop_reg,
    ylim       = c(0, 1), bar_width = 0.9,
    gp         = gpar(fill = cond_pal[cond_ord], col = NA),
    axis_param = list(side = "left", gp = gpar(fontsize = 7))
  ),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  annotation_name_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 8)
)

draw(
  Heatmap(
    heat_reg,
    name                 = "z-score\nmean score",
    col                  = colorRamp2(c(-2.5, 0, 2.5), c("#2166ac", "white", "#b2182b")),
    top_annotation       = col_ann_reg,
    cluster_rows         = as.dendrogram(hc_rows_reg),
    cluster_columns      = as.dendrogram(hc_cols_reg),
    column_names_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 9),
    row_names_gp         = gpar(fontsize = 8),
    border               = FALSE,
    column_title         = sprintf("%d clusters — positive regulon scores", ncol(heat_reg)),
    column_title_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 9),
    heatmap_legend_param = list(direction = "vertical")
  ),
  heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right"
)
```

```{r reg-umap-prom}
#| fig-height: 5

DimPlot(srt, group.by = CLUST_COL, reduction = "umap_reg_prom",
        label = TRUE) & NoLegend() |
  DimPlot(srt, group.by = CLUST_COL, reduction = "umap.nn",

```

```{r reg-umap-prom-cond}
  DimPlot(srt, group.by = "condition", reduction = "umap.nn") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cond_pal, name = "Condition")
```


## 13 — ATAC only (ImmGenATAC18)

ImmGen ATAC-seq OCRs gene-linked within 100 kb, without promoter windows.
Captures distal regulatory elements missed by promoter-window scanning.

### 13.1 — Motif scan

```{r atac-scan}
srt <- AugmentMotifScanWithBED(
  seurat_obj = srt,
  gr_list    = list(atac = yoshida_2020_ocr_linked_orig),
  pfm        = pfm_set,
  wgcna_name = "hsc_modules"
)
```

### 13.2 — Overlap motifs with modules

```{r atac-overlap}
srt <- OverlapModulesMotifs(srt, wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")

motif_df <- GetMotifOverlap(srt, wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")
motif_genes_df <- GetMotifs(srt)

motif_df <- dplyr::left_join(
  motif_df,
  motif_genes_df[, c("motif_ID", "motif_name")],
  by = c("tf" = "motif_ID")
)

tf_genes      <- unique(motif_genes_df$gene_name)
modules_net   <- GetModules(srt, wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")
nongrey_genes <- subset(modules_net, module != "grey")$gene_name
genes_use     <- unique(c(tf_genes, nongrey_genes))

srt <- SetWGCNAGenes(srt, genes_use, wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")
srt <- SetDatExpr(srt,
                  group_name = unique(srt$sample.name),
                  group.by   = "sample.name",
                  assay      = "SCT",
                  layer      = "data",
                  wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")

model_params <- list(
  objective = "reg:squarederror",
  max_depth = 1,
  eta       = 0.1,
  nthread   = 16,
  alpha     = 0.5
)
srt <- ConstructTFNetwork(
  srt,
  model_params = model_params,
  wgcna_name   = "hsc_modules"
)

cat("motif_df rows:", nrow(motif_df), "\n")
```

## 15 — Distal ATAC only (ImmGenATAC18 non-promoter OCRs)

OCRs from ImmGenATAC18 that do **not** overlap any mm10 protein-coding promoter
window. These represent putative distal regulatory elements (enhancers,
silencers, insulators) whose motif contribution is absent from §12 (promoters)
but present in §13 (ATAC all). Comparing §15 vs §12 isolates the distal
regulatory layer.

### 15.0 — Disjoin promoters from OCRs

```{r distal-disjoin}
distal_mask <- !IRanges::overlapsAny(
  yoshida_2020_ocr_linked_orig$gr,
  mm10_protein_coding_promoters_gr,
  ignore.strand = TRUE
)

n_total    <- length(yoshida_2020_ocr_linked_orig$gr)
n_distal   <- sum(distal_mask)
n_proximal <- n_total - n_distal

cat(sprintf("Total OCRs:            %d\n",          n_total))
cat(sprintf("Promoter-overlapping:  %d (%.1f%%)\n", n_proximal, 100 * n_proximal / n_total))
cat(sprintf("Distal (non-promoter): %d (%.1f%%)\n", n_distal,   100 * n_distal   / n_total))

distal_names <- names(yoshida_2020_ocr_linked_orig$gr)[distal_mask]

yoshida_distal <- list(
  gr        = yoshida_2020_ocr_linked_orig$gr[distal_mask],
  peak_gene = subset(yoshida_2020_ocr_linked_orig$peak_gene,
                     reduced_name %in% distal_names)
)

cat(sprintf("Distal peak-gene links: %d\n", nrow(yoshida_distal$peak_gene)))
```

### 15.1 — Motif scan

```{r distal-scan}
srt <- AugmentMotifScanWithBED(
  seurat_obj = srt,
  gr_list    = list(atac_distal = yoshida_distal),
  pfm        = pfm_set,
  wgcna_name = "hsc_modules"
)
```

### 15.2 — Overlap motifs with modules

```{r distal-overlap}
srt <- OverlapModulesMotifs(srt, wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")

motif_df <- GetMotifOverlap(srt, wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")
motif_genes_df <- GetMotifs(srt)

motif_df <- dplyr::left_join(
  motif_df,
  motif_genes_df[, c("motif_ID", "motif_name")],
  by = c("tf" = "motif_ID")
)

tf_genes      <- unique(motif_genes_df$gene_name)
modules_net   <- GetModules(srt, wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")
nongrey_genes <- subset(modules_net, module != "grey")$gene_name
genes_use     <- unique(c(tf_genes, nongrey_genes))

srt <- SetWGCNAGenes(srt, genes_use, wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")
srt <- SetDatExpr(srt,
                  group_name = unique(srt$sample.name),
                  group.by   = "sample.name",
                  assay      = "SCT",
                  layer      = "data",
                  wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")

model_params <- list(
  objective = "reg:squarederror",
  max_depth = 1,
  eta       = 0.1,
  nthread   = 16,
  alpha     = 0.5
)
srt <- ConstructTFNetwork(
  srt,
  model_params = model_params,
  wgcna_name   = "hsc_modules"
)

cat("motif_df rows:", nrow(motif_df), "\n")
```

### 15.3 — TF regulons

```{r distal-tf-regulons}
srt <- AssignTFRegulons(
  srt,
  strategy   = "C",
  reg_thresh = 0.1,
  wgcna_name = "hsc_modules"
)

results <- GetTFNetwork(srt, wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")
cat("TF–gene pairs after regulon assignment:", nrow(results), "\n")
```

### 15.4 — Top TF targets

```{r distal-regulon-barplot}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
cur_tf <- "Foxo1"
RegulonBarPlot(srt, selected_tf = cur_tf, wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")
```

### 15.5 — Regulon scores

```{r distal-regulon-scores}
srt <- RegulonScores(
  srt,
  target_type        = "positive",
  exclude_grey_genes = FALSE,
  cor_thresh         = 0.05,
  ncores             = 8,
  wgcna_name         = "hsc_modules"
)
srt <- RegulonScores(
  srt,
  target_type        = "negative",
  exclude_grey_genes = FALSE,
  cor_thresh         = -0.05,
  ncores             = 8,
  wgcna_name         = "hsc_modules"
)

pos_regulon_scores <- GetRegulonScores(srt, target_type = "positive",
                                       wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")
neg_regulon_scores <- GetRegulonScores(srt, target_type = "negative",
                                       wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")

cat("Regulon score matrix dims (pos):", dim(pos_regulon_scores), "\n")
```

### 15.6 — Regulon UMAP

```{r distal-regulon-umap}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 4

srt$pos_regulon_score <- pos_regulon_scores[, cur_tf]
srt$neg_regulon_score <- neg_regulon_scores[, cur_tf]

p1 <- FeaturePlot(srt, feature = cur_tf) + umap_theme()
p2 <- FeaturePlot(srt, feature = "pos_regulon_score",
                  cols = c("lightgrey", "red")) + umap_theme()
p3 <- FeaturePlot(srt, feature = "neg_regulon_score",
                  cols = c("lightgrey", "seagreen")) + umap_theme()
p1 | p2 | p3
```

```{r distal-regulon-module-heatmap}
p1 <- ModuleRegulatoryHeatmap(srt, feature = "positive",

p2 <- ModuleRegulatoryHeatmap(srt, feature = "negative",

p1 | p2
```

### 15.8 — TF regulon–trait correlation

```{r distal-regulon-trait-correlation}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6

cond_vec  <- label_condition(srt$sample.name)
trait_mat <- model.matrix(~ 0 + factor(cond_vec))
colnames(trait_mat) <- levels(factor(cond_vec))

cor_res  <- WGCNA::corAndPvalue(pos_regulon_scores, trait_mat)
r_mat    <- cor_res$cor
p_mat    <- cor_res$p
q_mat    <- matrix(p.adjust(p_mat, "BH"), nrow = nrow(p_mat),
                   dimnames = dimnames(p_mat))
sig_mat  <- ifelse(q_mat < 0.0005, "*", "")

Heatmap(
  r_mat,
  name     = "Pearson r",
  col      = colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("#2166ac", "white", "#b2182b")),
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    if (sig_mat[i, j] != "")
      grid::grid.text(sig_mat[i, j], x, y, gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"))
  },
  cluster_rows    = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  row_names_gp    = gpar(fontsize = 9),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
  column_title    = "Condition",
  row_title       = "Module"
)
```

### 15.9 — Regulon activity heatmap by cluster

```{r distal-regulon-cluster-heatmap}
#| fig-height: 16
#| fig-width: 14

shared_cells_reg <- intersect(rownames(pos_regulon_scores), colnames(srt))
reg_mat  <- pos_regulon_scores[shared_cells_reg, , drop = FALSE]
cl_vec   <- srt@meta.data[shared_cells_reg, CLUST_COL]

agg      <- rowsum(reg_mat, cl_vec)
cl_n     <- as.numeric(table(cl_vec)[rownames(agg)])
agg_mean <- sweep(agg, 1, cl_n, "/")

heat_reg <- t(scale(agg_mean))
heat_reg <- heat_reg[complete.cases(heat_reg), ]

hc_rows_reg <- hclust(dist(heat_reg),    method = "ward.D2")
hc_cols_reg <- hclust(dist(t(heat_reg)), method = "ward.D2")

cond_cells <- srt$condition[shared_cells_reg]
prop_reg   <- prop.table(table(cl_vec, cond_cells), margin = 1)
prop_reg   <- as.matrix(prop_reg)
cond_ord   <- intersect(c("WT", "mCh-", "mCh+"), colnames(prop_reg))
prop_reg   <- prop_reg[rownames(agg_mean), cond_ord, drop = FALSE]

col_ann_reg <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  `Condition mix` = anno_barplot(
    prop_reg,
    ylim       = c(0, 1), bar_width = 0.9,
    gp         = gpar(fill = cond_pal[cond_ord], col = NA),
    axis_param = list(side = "left", gp = gpar(fontsize = 7))
  ),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  annotation_name_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 8)
)

draw(
  Heatmap(
    heat_reg,
    name                 = "z-score\nmean score",
    col                  = colorRamp2(c(-2.5, 0, 2.5), c("#2166ac", "white", "#b2182b")),
    top_annotation       = col_ann_reg,
    cluster_rows         = as.dendrogram(hc_rows_reg),
    cluster_columns      = as.dendrogram(hc_cols_reg),
    column_names_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 9),
    row_names_gp         = gpar(fontsize = 8),
    border               = FALSE,
    column_title         = sprintf("%d clusters — positive regulon scores (distal ATAC)", ncol(heat_reg)),
    column_title_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 9),
    heatmap_legend_param = list(direction = "vertical")
  ),
  heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right"
)
```
